description: Mark an outreach lead as having replied outside LinkedIn (by email or phone), so future reports stop flagging it as awaiting a reply. Requires the can-mark-leads permission; an own-leads-only key can only mark its own conversations. Idempotent: an already-marked lead returns unchanged:true with no notification; a real change notifies the Fractional Teams team.

contact_name.description: The lead's name, for the audit trail

conversation_id.description: The conversation id from a report lead card or get_lead_status

name: mark_lead_replied_outside
